description: Get a link where the signed-in person sees their own clothes on them. Pass `outfit_id` for a saved outfit (ids come from list_saved_outfits or create_saved_outfit), or `item_ids` for a look that is not saved (for example the items suggest_outfit returned, or a single item). Returns `try_on_url`: give it to the person exactly as returned, including everything after the `?`, because the page cannot open without it. On that page they add a full-length photo of themselves and Alama makes the picture, the same try-on as in the Alama app; it is also saved to their try-ons there. The link works for one hour. You never receive the photo or the picture, so do not ask the person to send you a photo and do not draw the look yourself. Items without a photo are left out and listed in `skipped`, each with a link to add one. Try-ons have a daily allowance; `allowance` says what is left. Changes nothing in the wardrobe.
